_metadata.description: Key works and manuscripts in the network

works.title: Chirurgia Magna
works.author: Lanfranchi of Milan
works.key_features: Autobiographical prologue and epilogue; dedicated to Philip IV; argued surgery and medicine inseparable
works.german_MSS_note: Three High German translations of Chirurgia parva survive; Erlangen MS B 3 (1484) contains this + Rupescissa

works.title: De consideratione quintae essentiae
works.author: John of Rupescissa
works.key_features: Foundational text linking distillation to universal medicine; described as 'singularissimi ac secreti valde' (most singular and very secret); 1/3 of Brunschwig's Large Book derives from this
works.voynich_relevance: HIGH - direct theoretical source for the distillation tradition we model

works.title: Buchlein von den ausgebrannten Wassern
works.author: Michael Puff von Schrick
works.key_features: 84 chapters on distilled waters and pharmaceutical uses; Brunschwig's acknowledged main source; later combined with Brunschwig as 'Apoteck fur den gemeinen Mann' (1619)
works.voynich_relevance: HIGH - our primary Puff connection; Phase 490 tested structural alignment

works.title: Liber de arte distillandi de simplicibus (Small Book)
works.author: Hieronymus Brunschwig
works.key_features: First printed distillation manual; vernacular German for barber-surgeons and laypeople; originated from questions about 'how to prepare, use and store the waters'

works.title: Liber de arte distillandi de compositis (Large Book)
works.author: Hieronymus Brunschwig
works.key_features: Title includes 'die brosamlin gefallen von den buchern d'Artzny... geoffenbart' (crumbs fallen from medical books, REVEALED); 1/3 of quintessence chapters from Rupescissa; explicit framing as DISCLOSURE of hidden knowledge; cites Rupescissa 7+ times
works.secrecy_note: The word 'geoffenbart' (revealed/disclosed) in the title presupposes a prior regime of secrecy

works.title: Buch der Chirurgia
works.author: Hieronymus Brunschwig
works.key_features: First printed books on surgery available in English translation

works.title: Alchymey Teuczsch
works.author: Niklas Jankowitz et al.
works.binding_note: Bound in a parchment diploma from the Landgraves of Leuchtenberg concerning Jewish alchemist Salman Teublein's obligation to keep his art secret

cipher_details.authors_statement: We ourselves created this new alphabet so that one would not recognize it as an alphabet
cipher_details.selective_encryption: Only alchemical content ciphered; medical, astrological, magical content in cleartext
cipher_details.decknamen_layer: Additional word-level encoding: gold = 'gelbe Erde' (yellow earth), silver = 'weisse Erde' (white earth), saltpeter = 'Salzstein' (salt stone)
cipher_details.vulnerability: Breakable via word endings (Wortausgaenge) — common German suffixes remain identifiable

contents_by_folio.5v-47r: Alchemical and medical formulas (alchemical portions encrypted)
contents_by_folio.47v-48r: Michael von Prapach: Verworfene Tage (astrological timing calendar)
contents_by_folio.48r-49v: Magical formulas incl. Wulfing's fever incantation and love spell
contents_by_folio.54r-58v: Additional alchemical and medical formulas (partially encrypted)
contents_by_folio.91r: Letter address formula mentioning Bishop of Passau
contents_by_folio.93r-94v: Miscellaneous notes incl. 1423 gold multiplication entry

works.voynich_relevance: VERY HIGH - cipher manuscript from same region/period as Voynich; demonstrates Bavarian alchemists using multiple invented cipher systems; double secrecy layer (cipher + Decknamen)
sources: Wattenbach, Anzeiger fur Kunde der deutschen Vorzeit 16 (1869)

works.title: Bellicorum instrumentorum liber
works.author: Giovanni Fontana
works.cipher_details: Simple substitution cipher with invented signs (no letters/numbers); first sentence of each description in Latin, remainder in cipher; relatively easy to read by design
works.voynich_relevance: VERY HIGH - Padua physician using invented cipher at exact Voynich radiocarbon date

works.title: Secretum de thesauro experimentorum ymaginationis hominum
works.author: Giovanni Fontana
works.cipher_details: Describes mnemonic machines; substantially written in same cipher as W008

works.title: Antidotarius animae
works.author: Nicolaus Salicetus
works.key_features: Primarily devotional/spiritual despite author's medical credentials; same printer as Brunschwig's works

works.title: Arzneibuch
works.author: Ortolf von Baierland
works.key_features: Foundational German-language medical text; peak popularity 15th C; Bavarian-East Franconian-Alsatian distribution

works.title: Buch der Natur
works.author: Konrad von Megenberg
works.key_features: First natural history in German; first printed botanical woodcuts

works.title: Krauterbuch
works.author: Johannes Hartlieb
works.key_features: 160 plants with medicinal properties, humoral classifications, AND magical associations; bridges medicine and occult

works.title: Buch aller verbotenen Kunst
works.author: Johannes Hartlieb
works.key_features: Treatise on magic and sorcery; oldest known description of witches' flying ointment; lunar divination; art of memory

works.title: Fasciculus medicinae
works.author: Johannes de Ketham (compiler)
works.key_features: First printed medical book with anatomical illustrations; 6 independent medieval treatises including Mondino's Anathomia; Vienna author, Venice publisher = Vienna-Venice axis

works.title: Gart der Gesundheit
works.author: Johann Wonnecke von Kaub
works.key_features: First printed illustrated German herbal; 435 chapters, 379 woodcuts

works.title: Coelum philosophorum
works.author: Philipp Ulstad
works.key_features: Synthesized entire quintessence tradition (Rupescissa, pseudo-Arnald, pseudo-Lull, Brunschwig)

works.title: Libreto de Aqua Ardente
works.author: Michele Savonarola
works.key_features: First treatise entirely dedicated to distilled spirits; distinguished air-cooled from coil-condensed distillation

works.title: Liber de simplicibus
works.author: Nicolo Roccabonella
works.key_features: 458 chapters; illustrated by Andrea Amadio; handwritten for his son in medical school; plant names in Latin, Greek, Arabic, and Italian dialects

works.title: Erlangen MS B 3
works.author: anonymous copyist
works.key_features: Contains BOTH Lanfranchi's surgical texts AND Rupescissa's quintessence treatise copied together — proves these traditions were studied by same readers
works.voynich_relevance: Shows surgery + alchemical distillation combined in single MS

works.title: Secretum Secretorum
works.author: pseudo-Aristotle
works.date: Latin trans. early 13th C (Philip of Tripoli)
works.key_features: Most widely copied 'secret knowledge' text of medieval period; covers statecraft, medicine, alchemy, astrology, magic; established cultural norm that important knowledge = 'secrets'
